top_signals.title: China Factory Activity Expands But Ends Streak of Faster Growth
top_signals.summary: China’s factory activity expanded last month while growing at a slower pace for the first time since July, a private survey showed, in further evidence of the resilience of the country’s export-oriented firms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers
top_signals.summary: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: OpenAI says it's doubling Pro usage limits and bringing Work features to Chat
top_signals.summary: OpenAI has just confirmed that it's rolling out ChatGPT Work capabilities directly into regular Chat, while also combining usage allowances across ChatGPT and Codex. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Announcement of Capital Participation and Business Alliance with Holding Company (MI Company Inc.) of Media Business Companies Mediagene Inc. and INFOBAHN Inc.
top_signals.summary: News2u Holdings Inc. (Headquarters: Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo; President and CEO: Minako Suematsu) hereby announces that it will promote strategic business cooperation through capital participation in MI Company Inc. (Headquarters: Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; CEO: Motoko Imada).
